title: Authenticate item consumers for the Hunter comparison
platforms: USA and EUR ROM static analysis
changes: Document that two authenticated consumers use the five halfwords affected by the observed ordinary Hunter transition as item-table indices.
validation: A protected read-only unit compared the retained ordinary and paired USA records, authenticated both ROMs, verified the two direct item-getter calls and matched the complete 376-entry USA/EUR tables. The ordinary route cleared the five values while the paired write retained them. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-job-item-consumer-45iaunf6/.
limitations: Static consumers do not prove execution on the observed route, identify the displayed equipment slots, or establish complete job-change behavior, learned skills or battle safety.
